newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic Corp Q4 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic Corp Q4 earnings summary.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1995 net shr includes a $0.01 a share loss from the cumulative effect of a change in accounting principle, making fourth quarter operating earnings $0.79 vs $0.90.

Telecommunications companies are allowed to make accounting changes specific to their industry, including directory accounting changes, regulatory changes and other items. Adjusted to exclude these items and the accounting change item above, Bell Atlantic earned $0.97 a share compared to $0.90 a share for the fourth quarter.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: 1996 net shr includes a $0.32 a share gain from the cumulative effect of a change in accounting principle. 1995 net shr includes a $0.01 a share loss from the cumulative effect of a change in accounting principle. Excluding these items, operating earnings per share were $4.28 vs $4.24.
Adjusted to exclude industry-specific items and the accounting changes mentioned above, Bell Atlantic earned $4.26 a share compared to $3.88 a share in 1995.
